cloaca.definition: n. (zoology) the cavity (in birds, reptiles, amphibians, most fish, and monotremes but not mammals) at the end of the digestive tract into which the intestinal, genital, and urinary tracts open
cloaca.translation:
n. 泄殖腔, 阴沟
[医] 泄殖腔, 一穴肛; 骨瘘

cloaca vesicorectovaginal.translation: [医] 膀胱直肠阴道泄殖腔

cloacae.definition:
n (zoology) the cavity (in birds, reptiles, amphibians, most fish, and monotremes but not mammals) at the end of the digestive tract into which the intestinal, genital, and urinary tracts open
n a waste pipe that carries away sewage or surface water
cloacae.translation: n. 阴沟, 厕所, 下水道, 泄殖腔

cloacal.definition: a. Of or pertaining to a cloaca.
cloacal.translation:
a. 阴沟, 厕所, 下水道, 泄殖腔
[医] 泄殖腔的

cloacal duct.translation: [医] 泄殖腔管, 赖黑耳氏一穴肛管

cloacal hillock.translation: [医] 生殖丘, 生殖结节

cloacal membranes.translation: [医] 泄殖腔膜, 一穴肛膜

cloacal plate.translation: [医] 泄殖腔膜, 一穴肛膜

cloacas.definition:
plural of cloaca

cloacas.translation:
(cloaca 的复数) n. 泄殖腔, 阴沟

cloacitis.translation: [医] 泄殖腔炎, 一穴肛炎

n. a room where coats and other articles can be left temporarily
